ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, in rhombus $ABCD$, the lengths of the two diagonals are $AC=6$ and $BD=8$. What is the area of this rhombus?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Since quadrilateral ABCD is a rhombus, \\
the area of the rhombus = $\frac{1}{2}$AC$\cdot$BD = $\frac{1}{2} \times 6 \times 8 = \boxed{24}$.
